list.name: target
list.label: Target
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT target FROM smokeping.latency WHERE target NOT IN ('Cloudflare', 'Quad9') AND measurement_type <> 'dns_latency' ORDER BY target

targets.query: SELECT timestamp, avg_latency as average FROM smokeping.latency WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime64($__from/1000, 3) AND timestamp <= toDateTime64($__to/1000, 3) AND target IN (${target:sqlstring}) AND measurement_type <> 'dns_latency' AND avg_latency > 0 ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT timestamp, avg_latency as mean FROM smokeping.latency WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime64($__from/1000, 3) AND timestamp <= toDateTime64($__to/1000, 3) AND target IN (${target:sqlstring}) AND measurement_type <> 'dns_latency' AND avg_latency IS NOT NULL ORDER BY timestamp
